protocol.ack_encoding: compact ASCII JSON plus one newline; no expires_in_ms
protocol.expiry_basis: Conservative monotonic timestamp before challenge TCP connection, bounded again by run and LAN lease deadlines
protocol.sequence: Unsigned 64-bit positive integer; strictly greater than last acknowledged sequence
protocol.first_accepted_ack: Pins the new boot ID and exact SHA256 SSH server key fingerprint; all later boot/key changes fail closed
protocol.rejected_old_boot: No ACK is sent when challenge boot ID equals required previous boot ID
protocol.remote_rejections: Exit125 with empty stdout is retryable within deadlines; unexpected status/fields/output fail closed

trust_and_authentication.required_trust_file: Explicit --known-hosts, preverified device-local key via trusted stock SSH; no TOFU, no automatic enrollment
trust_and_authentication.trust_file_rules: Regular file, root/current-user owner, no group/world write, O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, 1MiB cap; target entry required
trust_and_authentication.ssh_policy: Paramiko RejectPolicy; no system key discovery or implicit agent/key use
auth_choices: Default one-time getpass password in memory
--key explicit private key (regular root/user-owned, no group/world access); optional --key-passphrase getpass
trust_and_authentication.host: Numeric IP only to avoid an unbounded DNS lookup

bounds.sleep_bound: Every sleep ends no later than the current LAN lease safety deadline. A duration endpoint coincident with a stale55s lease is failure, not success.

logs.format: JSONL to stdout and optional newly-created0600 file; existing paths/symlinks refused
logs.secrets: No password, passphrase, private-key bytes, raw challenge or raw SSH error/peer output logged
logs.exit: Explicit observer_stopped with trial_lan_lease_may_expire=true and permanent_acceptance=false, including SIGINT/SIGTERM

peer_review.finding: Sleep previously could exceed55s lease safety cutoff after failed RPCs; duration equality also needed a stale-lease check.
peer_review.resolution: Both corrected, with dedicated tests proving ACK0 then5s failures at15/30/45 stops exactly55, and duration55 returns failure.
peer_review.additional_hardening: Known-hosts FIFO cannot block before fstat due O_NONBLOCK; tested.

limitations: No actual SSH server or native trial-ack target process was used in these tests; sockets and Paramiko sessions are mocked and any unmocked socket creation raises.
The native helper/guardian integration must receive separate target SSH fixture acceptance before live observer use.
This tool only renews a temporary LAN health lease; it has no command that writes metadata, commits a boot, resets a device or enrolls trust.
OS scheduling suspension, SIGKILL or host power loss cannot guarantee a final log record; the native guard remains responsible for lease expiration and rollback.
